title: player-visibility-toggle
description: Simple, Powerful, and Customizable Visibility Toggling.
body:
Overview
Tired of crowded lobbies where you can't see anything? Minecraft-Visibility is a lightweight and easy-to-use plugin that allows players to toggle the visibility of others with a single command or item click. Perfect for Hub, Lobby, or Minigame servers to reduce visual clutter and improve performance for players!

Key Features
Toggle Visibility: Easily hide or show all other players.

Lightweight & Fast: Optimized code to ensure zero lag on your server.

Perfect for Hubs: Give your players a cleaner experience in crowded areas.

Simple Configuration: Easy to set up and ready to use out of the box.

Commands
/visibility - Main command to toggle player visibility. 

Permissions
visibility.use - Allows players to use the toggle feature.
